name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Registered Organizations/Government Organization/Non-Government Organizations/Institutions for Running Residential Facilities/Half Way Homes for Persons with Disabilities
benefit:
##### ***Operational Grant***

- Maximum operational grant of ₹4,00,000/- per month.
- **Payment to Medical Officer/Councilor/Therapist:** ₹60,000/- per month.- **Payment to team of Administrative Staff (Manager, Clerk, and six Attendants/Care takers/Aayas/Drivers):** ₹1,34,000/- per month.- **Administrative Expenses (Rent/Maintenance/Electricity/Water/Telephone, Mobile, Newspaper, etc.):** ₹46,00
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be a registered voluntary organization, Non-Governmental Organization, Government Organization, or Institution. - The applicant must be engaged in the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. - The applying Organization must bear 25% of the cost proposed. - The grantee Institution should be capable of mobilizing the community towards the cause. - The grantee Institution should be capable of effective networking with other institutions for optimum utilization of allocated resources.
##### ***Conditions Applicable ONLY to Non-Government Organizations/Institutions (Government Organizations are exempted from these)*** - The grantee institution must be registered as per Section 50 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and its further amendments. - The Organization must have a minimum of 20 inmates at the time of applying for the scheme. - The grantee institution must have at least one year of field experience in the empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. - The grantee institution must maintain financial viability to independently sustain the operation of residential facilities or halfway homes for a minimum period of three months in the event of delays in the release of operational grants or scheme discontinuation. - The grantee institution must have a good reputation and credibility with no cases of criminal offence registered against the said organization/institution. - The grantee institution/organization must have accessible physical and digital infrastructure.
